author: Motherhecker576
body: not sure if im doing this right but I was in a lobby playing nebula with a hacker, I didn't know him but he got on 3 different accounts, and spammed and hacked. before he got banned he was spamming Hello, my name is Braeden, as a joke I repeated this twice and instantly got banned, no proof that I was the same person, were on different ips and I just want to get unbanned

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Braeden,

Your IP's are different, but you probably shouldn't have done that. That indicates to Mods that it's the same guy who was ban evading. 

Next time, try not to do that, I won't be as merciful. 

Your infraction has been deleted.
